title: Only one detail opens at a time, some controls don't expand a tile
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. A workplace with data in every tile.
custom_steps:
1. Expand one tile, then expand another; confirm at most one tile's detail is open and the previously open detail closes.
2. Confirm only the 'View details' control expands or collapses a tile.
3. Confirm selecting the date-range/inactivity-window control does not expand the tile, and selecting the report link does not expand the tile.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • At most one tile's detail is open at a time.
  • Expanding a tile while another's detail is open closes the previously open detail.
  • Only the "View details" control expands or collapses a tile.
  • Selecting the date-range or inactivity-window control on a tile does not expand the tile.
  • Selecting the report link on a tile does not expand the tile.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9578 (S6 — Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S6; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R9: “At most one tile's detail is open at a time.”
  • S6-R10: “When the user expands a tile while another tile's detail is open, the previously open detail closes.”
  • S6-R11: “Only the "View details" control expands or collapses a tile.”
  • S6-R12: “Selecting the date-range or inactivity-window control on a tile does not expand the tile.”
  • S6-R13: “Selecting the report link on a tile does not expand the tile.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
